title: Next.js in Production
prereqs: Docker + kind for the deploy challenge
description: Ship Next.js like a pro (your primary stack): the App Router & file conventions, Server vs Client Components, data fetching & caching (fetch cache, revalidation, PPR), Server Actions & mutations, route handlers & middleware, streaming & Suspense, auth patterns, performance (bundle, images, fonts), and deploying — each a runnable, test/build-judged exercise.
